name: Clara Hardmead
source:
The Music Teacher at Ouran High School and College and Frauke Mann's long time friend and confidant. She's a strict teacher that doesn't take kindly to any of her students' antics. Mike used to have a massive crush on her when he studied there, maybe he still has, who knows?
